payload.text: Molt 1.4.1, hv 2026-11-04: pplr-dc rewrites Molt's pplr liberator in cldr.sh's Homebrew shape (pplr 2.x has no bin/pplr, so molt upgrade fails on rhadamanth and gyges), then prepares the 'Release v1.4.1' commit. vc verifies it, and hv cuts by Molt's documented hand steps (tag, push, CI on the tag, tools/formula publish). Then hv runs molt upgrade --self && molt upgrade && molt maintain on rhadamanth, gyges and kovacs. Moving Molt onto devbin's one-command release is a later job, for Molt's own nodes.
